report_topic: Implementation of Deendayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)/ Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana (SAUBHAGYA)
observations_summary: The audit found significant cost and time overruns due to deficiencies in planning, implementation, and monitoring of the schemes. Issues included inadequate field surveys, extra expenditure on materials and consultants, non-levy of liquidated damages, and failure to ensure proper energy accounting and statutory clearances, leading to deferred benefits and loss of subsidy.
